title: SG-3.1 · Create the missing top-level App component
summary: Add game/frontend/src/App.tsx so main.tsx compiles and the opening scene is playable
description: Context: game/frontend/src/main.tsx imports './App', but App.tsx does not exist. The pieces already exist: useGame, IntroScreen, SceneView, ActionMenu, StoryPanel and GameLayout. Desired behavior: App uses useGame to show IntroScreen first, then SceneView, ActionMenu and StoryPanel inside GameLayout. Expected result: the entry point compiles and the opening bedroom scene can be played. Why: this is the missing top-level piece for the playable 80/20 frontend.
acceptance_criteria: Given the app starts, when App renders, then the intro copy and a Begin button are shown and no scene hotspots are present
Given the intro is shown, when Begin is clicked, then the bedroom scene with hotspot buttons, the story panel with the boy's opening dialogue, and the Story drawer toggle are rendered
Given the scene is shown, when a hotspot is clicked and an action button is pressed, then the game state changes and the result appears in the story history

in_scope: game/frontend/src/App.tsx composing existing components with useGame
out_of_scope: Changes to existing components, useGame or the engine
preserve: main.tsx import of './App' as default export
GameLayout, useGame and component props as they are

technical_constraints: Reuse components in game/frontend/src/components and useGame from src/runtime/useGame.ts
definition_of_done: Opening scene is playable through intro, hotspot, action and dialogue choice
